items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I recorded George Lewis and Buck Johnson.

ctx.x: Well okay, well if you'd contact Mrs. Alice Justin at 1429 Domaine Street. Oh yes. It's right across the street from the old San Jacinto Club.
I recorded there. I recorded George Lewis and Buck Johnson. Oh did you? Yes, in 1944. I recorded there one whole week, six nights. Oh, that used to be quite a spot.
Well do you remember the old Lions Club which is located about three blocks from there? No. Near Claiborne Street.
